findings.summary: Private evidence publication remains vulnerable to pathname races.
evidence: V8 opens an anchored parent descriptor but unlinks recovery temporary files and performs link/cleanup through absolute pathnames.
A parent or leaf swap can redirect publication or delete a replacement before postflight detects drift.

findings.summary: Existing-file convergence can overwrite a concurrently introduced third state.
evidence: The V8 runner passes only the original digest to its filesystem bridge and discards journal inode identity.
Two replacing renames and pathname unlink can overwrite a raced target or discard leaf.

findings.summary: Completed transaction markers do not retain verifiable journal identity.
evidence: The runner creates a new marker inode while encoding the separate journal inode in its filename.
Marker-only replay does not compare the marker inode with the encoded identity.

findings.summary: The production program gate can pass an incomplete or mixed transition state.
evidence: The V8 Program wrapper recognizes review state without checking transition digests or transaction outputs.
It invokes the authoritative continuation checker only after P107A is marked completed.

findings.summary: Completed-state validation depends on a hard-coded temporary base-anchor location.
evidence: The V8 Program wrapper hard-codes the Round23 anchor under /private/tmp.
Only continuation-anchor values are caller supplied, so relocation or cleanup of the valid base anchor breaks verification.
